To her left is a large red scroll graphic with black and gold text, accompanied by a small animated cartoon snake figure. She speaks directly to the camera, using frequent hand gestures such as palms together in a greeting position. The background features dark wood carvings and red decorative lanterns. (2) The scene cuts to a full-screen graphic background. A large stylized gold Chinese character for 'Spring' flashes briefly. Then, a 3D animated snake wearing traditional red attire and holding a lantern appears next to gold text '金蛇迎春 2025'. A web address is visible at the bottom of the screen against a red pattern background with cloud motifs.
